verdict.rationale: The evidence documents Audiences built manually from tracking events, traits, computed traits, and other Audiences. The only AI reference is a pricing-page tagline, "Build AI‑powered audiences," which does not describe natural-language input, AI-generated segment definitions, a review step, or grounding in the workspace schema. Natural-language audience building is a fair question for a CDP, so the axis applies; with no evidence of this capability, the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can describe an audience in natural language and AI builds the segment definition for review, grounded in my actual schema
